card.name: Words just before overall survival
card.fires_on: Linking or modifying words right before the word survival in cancer outcome text, such as 'and' or '-free' in 'progression-free and overall survival', or 'shorter' and 'worse' before time or outcome terms.

modes.label: Hyphen or 'and' in survival phrases
modes.description: The '-free', '-year' or 'and' inside phrases like progression-free and overall survival.
modes.example: Relapse-free<< and>> overall survival Decreased 3-year rel

modes.label: Worse-outcome adjectives
modes.description: Words like shorter or worse that lead into a survival or progression outcome.
modes.example: had a significantly<< worse>> clinical outcome, with a median overall survival

card.writes: It makes the word survival more likely to come next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before 'survival' in cancer outcome phrases, anticipating that word.
